errors.evidence: The figure does not contain a label for the X-axis. The description hallucinates the label 'Година' (Year).

errors.evidence: The figure does not contain a label for the Y-axis. The description hallucinates the label 'Стойности на TTI' (TTI Values).
The value for 2018 is visibly higher than the value for 2016 (around 0.56) and is approximately 0.58. The description incorrectly states it is around 0.55.

The description incorrectly expands the acronym TTI. TTI stands for Telecommunication Infrastructure Index, which is a component of the Electronic Government Development Index (EGDI), not the index itself.
